name: mentorship-boss
description: Turn Instagram comments into leads and booked calls from ChatGPT: comment-to-DM automations, leads, follow-up emails and texts, bookings, videos and scheduled posts.

interface.longDescription:
Mentorship Boss turns Instagram comments into leads and booked calls, right from ChatGPT. When someone comments a keyword like GUIDE on your post or reel, they get a DM within seconds with your guide, link or booking page, leave their email or phone, and then get your follow-up emails and texts.

Built for coaches, consultants, course creators and service businesses who get clients from Instagram.

Try asking:
- "When someone comments GUIDE on my latest reel, DM them my guide and ask for their email."
- "Which of my reels brought in the most leads this month?"
- "Write a 3-email follow-up for people who downloaded my guide."
- "Who is booked this week, and what times are open on Thursday?"
- "Make a short reel from this idea and schedule it for Friday at 9am."
- "Show me the replies my AI appointment setter wants me to approve."

What you can do:
- Instagram DM automation: create and edit comment-to-DM automations (keyword auto-replies). They can ask people to follow and to leave their email or phone, then send the guide, lead magnet or link you promised.
- Leads: see who left their email or phone, and each person's full history: comments, DMs, emails, texts and bookings.
- Follow-ups: write and change the emails and texts that go out after a comment or a website form, and see exactly when each one will send before anything is saved.
- Bookings: see who is booked, find open times, and book, move or cancel calls.
- AI appointment setter: read, edit and approve the replies it drafts before they go out.
- Results: comments, leads and bookings per post, per reel and per automation, and which hooks hold attention.
- Videos and posts: turn a recording of yourself into a captioned video with on-screen graphics, or make a short text-on-screen reel from an idea, then post it now or schedule it.
- Business profile: update what every AI writer in your account knows about your business, so posts, DMs and emails sound like you.

How it works: you sign in with your Mentorship Boss account. Every change is shown to you as a preview first and is only saved when you confirm, and nothing is posted, sent or booked unless you ask. The plugin only reaches the account you signed in with.

Limitations: your Instagram professional account, the sending email and the texting number are connected once in the Mentorship Boss console; the plugin gives you the link. Account settings are managed in the console. Some features, such as AI phone calls, are not available on every account, and the plugin says so when that applies.
capabilities: Create and edit Instagram comment-to-DM automations (keyword auto-replies)
Ask commenters to follow and leave their email or phone, then send a guide or link
Read leads and each person's full conversation and booking history
Write, preview and schedule follow-up emails and texts
See bookings and open times; book, move or cancel appointments
Review and send replies drafted by the AI appointment setter
Report comments, leads and bookings per post, reel and automation
Make captioned videos and text-on-screen reels, then post or schedule them
Update the business profile your AI writers work from

positive.prompt: Where does my account stand, and what should I do next?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the demo account's plan, connected accounts, leads, live automations and videos, then suggests one to three concrete next steps. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Show me my comment-to-DM automations and how many leads each one brought in.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each automation with its keyword, whether it is live, and its comment, lead and click counts from the demo data. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Edit a follow-up email with a preview before saving
positive.prompt: In my 'After a comment' follow-up, change the subject of the first email to 'Your free guide is inside'.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the sequence, shows the before/after of the subject as a preview and asks to confirm. Only after the user confirms does it save the change and report that it was saved.

positive.prompt: Who is booked in the next 7 days, and what times are open next Thursday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's upcoming appointments with name, local time and how they meet, then the open times for next Thursday in the account's timezone. Books nothing.

positive.prompt: Find the lead Jordan Lee and tell me everything that has happened with them.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the demo lead and gives a dated timeline of their form submission, emails, messages and bookings, with no invented events.

negative.description: Buying inside ChatGPT is not offered
negative.prompt: Buy 1,000 more credits for my account.
What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?
DM @some_random_account on Instagram and pitch them my coaching offer.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or purchased in ChatGPT. The plugin offers no plans, prices or purchases.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: clearer listing and starter prompts, Instagram only for now, and two new skills: make a reel, and write follow-ups. 1.0.2: clearer listing description and category. First release: comment-to-DM automations, leads and timelines, follow-up emails and texts with previews, bookings, AI setter approvals, post and automation results, videos and scheduled posts.
